13.t: Working with data: salt in our food
q: Which food has the least sodium?
What percentage of the daily limit is in one pack of instant noodles?
Explain why the body needs some sodium ions.
Na⁺ helps nerve impulses and muscle contraction, and controls water balance.
Plan a day’s meals with these foods that stays under 2000 mg. Explain the risk of eating too much.
e.g. bread, banana and pho = 2001 (just over) so swap pho for a home-cooked low-salt meal. Too much sodium raises blood pressure, a risk for heart disease and stroke.
